use_case: Automated tenant screening: the screening service scores each rental applicant and recommends approve, approve with a higher deposit, or decline (the registry's automated tenant and buyer screening; the owner does no automated buyer screening)
vendor_or_model: Online tenant screening service (vendor scoring model on consumer report, eviction, and criminal record data); click-through terms
data_categories: Applicant identity data; Social Security number (entered by the applicant); credit history; eviction filings and judgments; criminal records; stated income; score and recommendation
human_in_the_loop: From 2026-10-31: owner reviews every decline and conditional approval against written criteria, with individualized review of criminal and eviction records, before any recommendation goes to the landlord; until then the recommendation was used as the decision
applicable_laws: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604(a)-(b), (f) (landlord exemption in 3603(b)(1) lost when a broker is used); 24 CFR 100.500 (in force; removal proposed); FCRA 15 U.S.C. 1681m(a); 16 CFR 682.3; N53-R02 (45(a))

use_case: Generative AI writing assistant drafting listing descriptions and client emails
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI writing assistant (vendor large language model); consumer plan
data_categories: Listing details; until 2026-08 some pasted client names, budgets, and one pre-approval amount
human_in_the_loop: Owner edits every draft and checks listing copy for fair housing wording before publishing
applicable_laws: 42 U.S.C. 3604(c) (advertising); N53-R02 (45(a)); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) for any client data (now prohibited)
